Planner gate runs — bump this file to start one.

run 6 — Part A1, PR #137. Run 5 measured properly and failed honestly:
42 of 65, with 23 questions failing for four reasons. Three of them were
the validator rejecting CORRECT plans, and are now fixed:

  - a repeated role was treated as a repeated angle (22 rejections), but
    "compare karma-yoga and bhakti-yoga" wants two definitions;
  - naming Śrīla Prabhupāda as the speaker read as invented (15), though
    the whole library is his and "what did HE say" resolves to him;
  - "Bhagavad-gita 6.6" contains no "bg", so the correct constraint
    "Bg 6.6" read as invented (3).

The fourth was my own harness: latency was measured with six planner
calls in flight, which is not how a search runs. This run is serial.
